title: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
summary: Presides over the States negotiating resolution, suspends further Objectives Resolution debate and manages the transition into the Rules Committee report.

title: K. M. Munshi
summary: Moves the States Negotiating Committee resolution and presents the proposed Rules of Procedure, including Assembly sovereignty, language and committee structure.

title: Somnath Lahiri
summary: Demands Assembly ratification and direct representation of the people of princely States; later presses for time to amend the Rules.

title: Sri Prakasa
summary: Suggests a practical deadline for amendments to the States negotiating resolution.

title: Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha
summary: Seconds K. M. Munshi's resolution establishing the Constituent Assembly Negotiating Committee for Indian States.

title: P. R. Thakur
summary: Seeks a Depressed Classes member on the negotiating committee and later withdraws the amendment while maintaining the representation claim.

title: K. Santhanam
summary: Insists that no negotiating committee should replace the House as the final determining authority.

title: Dhirendra Nath Datta
summary: Supports a small consultative mechanism under the Cabinet Mission framework while opposing Lahiri's proposed negotiating instructions.

title: Jaipal Singh
summary: Argues that Adivasi knowledge and eastern princely-State experience should be represented on the negotiating committee.

title: B. G. Kher
summary: Rejects constructing the small negotiating committee through separate communal or sectional representation.

title: Jawaharlal Nehru
summary: Defines the negotiating committee's limited role and affirms that the final decision on its results remains with the Constituent Assembly.

title: Ajit Prasad Jain
summary: Questions how the Assembly, the Princes' negotiating body and other State representatives will reconcile different positions.

title: P. S. Deshmukh
summary: Supports giving negotiators flexibility rather than binding them to a predetermined method of State representation.

title: Diwan Chaman Lall
summary: Moves the accepted amendment explicitly requiring the negotiating committee to report its results back to the Assembly.

title: G. Durgabai
summary: Seconds the motion to consider the Rules in a Committee of the Whole with proceedings held in camera.

title: B. Shiva Rao
summary: Requests more time to study the newly circulated Rules report and consolidate amendments before detailed consideration.

title: Ananthasayanam Ayyangar
summary: Argues for proceeding rule by rule, adopting non-contentious provisions immediately and holding disputed ones over.
